gaps.reason: The Plan sets no application.domain, so the Android Release build uses the placeholder origin https://reading-club.invalid and the placeholder application ID invalid.firstdraft.reading_club.
gaps.consequence: The Release build points at these placeholders, so it cannot reach a server or be submitted to Google Play. Set application.domain, or replace both values, before a Release build; the application ID cannot change after the app is published.

gaps.reason: The Plan sets no application.domain, so the iOS Release build uses the placeholder origin https://reading-club.invalid and the placeholder bundle ID invalid.firstdraft.reading-club.
gaps.consequence: The Release build points at these placeholders, so it cannot reach a server or be submitted to the App Store. Set application.domain, or replace both values, before a Release build; the bundle ID cannot change after the app is published.
